## What / why

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Lint, type-check, tests green
- [ ] New tables have migration + RLS policy + RLS test
- [ ] Worker logic has unit tests (integration if it touches DB)
- [ ] Empty / error / loading states handled
- [ ] Reason codes added to catalog (if relevant)
- [ ] Docs updated (data dictionary / user guide)
- [ ] Any default deviation has an ADR in docs/adr/
